subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission method & sender header requirements
messages:
From: Sonia Park <sonia.park@clearwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: invoice delivery options and sample

Hi Jordan,

We're finalizing vendor setup for ClearWave and wanted to confirm your preferred invoice intake. Two quick questions before we spin up the supplier record: 

1) Do you prefer suppliers to submit invoices via the portal for production, or is emailing invoices to invoices@redwood.ai acceptable as a long-term delivery method?
2) Our ERP does not insert a subject token into outgoing emails by default. If we email invoices, can we instead include the PO in the filename (e.g., CW_INV_123456.csv) and rely on that? Also, what mandatory fields/headers do you require inside the CSV to allow automated PO matching?

I've attached a small mock CSV and a sample PDF for reference so you can see our typical layout.

Appreciate the guidance — we'd like to avoid manual rework on go-live.

Thanks,

Sonia Park
Accounts Payable
ClearWave Systems
[Attachment: clearwave_sample_rows.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: mock_invoice.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sonia Park <sonia.park@clearwave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 13:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: invoice delivery options and sample

Hi Sonia — thanks for the quick note and the sample files. Short answer: portal-first, email fallback with constraints. Details below so your ERP team can validate.

Portal vs email
- Portal is our recommended and supported path for production (idempotency, PO linking, and faster ACKs).
- We do accept email as a fallback during onboarding or for legacy partners for a transitional period, but we require strict filename and field conventions to support automated ingestion.

If you must email
- Send to: invoices@redwood.ai (this mailbox is routed to our ingest pipeline).
- Required filename pattern: CW_INV_{PO}.csv (example: CW_INV_123456.csv). If we receive an email without a compliant filename, ingestion will fall back to manual triage and delay payment.
- Email From: the sender should be a vendor-operated address (no generic forwarding alias) so we can reconcile the sender domain.
- Subject token: we normally use a subject token CW-INV-{PO} to make onboarding simple, but if your ERP can't add the token we can accept the filename approach above.

CSV required headers (minimal)
- po_number, invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), line_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, remit_name, remit_address
- First column MUST be po_number for reliable prefix matching.

Attachments
- I'm attaching our onboarding form and a sample CSV with the exact headers we expect. Please fill the onboarding form and return it with one representative CSV for the first invoice set.

Next steps
1) Please complete the attached Onboarding_Form_v1.pdf and return it with one representative CSV that follows the filename convention.
2) If SFTP is preferred, note that in the form and we'll route to Ops for keys.
3) Vanessa (cc'd) — once Sonia returns the filled form, can we treat ClearWave as "email-fallback" with a 90-day pilot, then move to portal?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Onboarding_Form_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: sample_invoice_rows.csv]

From: Sonia Park <sonia.park@clearwave.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:23:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: invoice delivery options and sample

Thanks Jordan — really helpful. A couple follow-ups from our side.

On Fri, May 20, 2027 at 1:05 PM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Portal vs email
> - Portal is our recommended and supported path for production (idempotency, PO linking, and faster ACKs).
> - We do accept email as a fallback during onboarding or for legacy partners for a transitional period, but we require strict filename and field conventions to support automated ingestion.

Constraints from our ERP
- We cannot inject a subject token automatically; that'll require a middleware change on our side.
- We can, however, control filename generation and will include the PO in the filename as CW_INV_{PO}.csv.
- We will make sure the first column of the CSV is po_number. Our sample CSV is attached (same format as the mock you provided).

SFTP
- SFTP is an option but will require our security team to open a tunnel and exchange keys; that takes longer than email for this vendor. If email fallback is acceptable for the first 60–90 days and we supply the filename and csv format you requested, we can plan SFTP in parallel.

ACKs
- We prefer an email acknowledgment when the invoice posts. If your pipeline can post an automated ACK to ap@clearwave.com after ingestion, that would close the loop for us.

I'll complete the onboarding form and return it with a sample CSV by EOD Monday.

Appreciate it,

Sonia Park
Accounts Payable
ClearWave Systems
[Attachment: clearwave_sample_rows.csv (updated)]

They will provide the completed onboarding form and a representative CSV by Monday. I propose we accept an email-fallback pilot (60–90 days) and configure our ingest pipeline to accept the filename pattern CW_INV_{PO}.csv for this vendor.

Requirements for Ops:
- Add vendor record "ClearWave Systems" and whitelist sender domain clearwave.com.
- Configure ingestion to parse filename for PO if subject token missing; require first column = po_number.
- Route ACK emails to ap@clearwave.com after ingestion success (automated).
- Mark this vendor as "email-fallback" and plan portal enrollment in 60–90 days.

Risk/notes:
- If invoices arrive without compliant filename or headers, route to manual triage and notify AP Ops.
- If ClearWave requests SFTP later, AP Ops to open ticket with security and schedule key exchange.

Next actions:
- Marcus: can you confirm we can add the parsing rule to the ingest pipeline by Wednesday?
- AP Ops: ready an ACK template and the vendor record.
- Vanessa: once the onboarding package arrives, please run the first sanity check and greenlight the pilot.
